lines: Pyre of Faith: its burn no longer lays ailments of its own (no ignite, poison, bleed or chill), as in the game since Patch 95. Its damage against a rare can read lower; its sheet DPS is unchanged.

Cast on Crit: Ballista, Ancestral Warrior and Horn of Jarls (totem skills), Unholy Void and Pyre of Faith no longer cast a linked spell on their crits, as in Patch 95 (tested in game for the Ballista). Arrow Totem shots still do.
Recent Patch: In short lines for Patch 95 (Trap Support, support and skill lifts, Golem and Skeletal Mage growth, Area passives).
Sim Supports: the progress bar no longer sits at 91% during the last passes, and an error ends the search with the setups found so far.

Oaths: a seat now opens with any notable of its cluster, as in the game since build 94, not only the notable next to it. Oaths sworn that way (for example Oath of the Stone Root with only Oathstone Body taken) were left out before, so life, armour and damage could read lower than in the game.

Tree optimizer: with Keep defence notables on, Entropy notables (such as Stillness Before Ruin) were kept as if they were defence notables, even after you took out Chaos support. They are now refunded when they add nothing.

Gear finders (Gear Set Sim, Sim by Slot, Best Rivenstone): skills that use two-handed weapons, such as Cyclone, Slash and Leap Slam, are now tried with two-handed swords, axes, maces and spears. Before, only scythes, staves and paired weapons were tried, so Oathwords like Maelstrom were suggested on a scythe.

Empty sockets on a skill gem below level 20 now cost what the game log shows: more than before for gems of level 11 to 19 (a level 17 gem with 2 of 5 supports deals 57% of its damage, we showed 69%). Fully linked skills and level 20 gems are unchanged.

Way of the Blade (Samurai keystone) and other repeat lines from gear or the passive tree no longer add a repeat to Cyclone or other channelled skills; as the keystone says, channelled skills never repeat. The tree optimizer had been suggesting Way of the Blade for Cyclone builds because of this.
Also count list: a Cast on Crit skill shows "with main" in place of a weight, since its damage adds to the main skill's.
Cyclone: it pulses at most every 0.1 s; attack speed past that adds nothing. Your weapon's own attacks per second does not change how fast it spins, only your attack speed lines do (tested in game).
Dual wielding: your swings alternate between the two weapons, so the damage is now the average of both (it used only the main hand). The 25% more attack speed for two weapons is now checked in game.
Dexterity gives attack speed again even when it is not your highest attribute (game patch 94, tested on a Warrior and a Ranger).
Bastion's Reckoning: its 6% less Attack and Cast Speed now slows attacks too, as in the game.

Hunter's Patience and other "after you stand still" lines: the game's character sheet leaves them out, so the hit and panel DPS here do too. The vs-enemy DPS still counts them while you fight standing still.

Temper every support gem: a new setting (on, level 5) counts each support at that Forge Tempering level everywhere; a gem tempered higher keeps its own level. Turn it off to use only the levels from your save.

New Players? tab (after FAQ): the six classes with their weapons and starting gems, the game rules you meet first, a guide to every tab of this site, and the 19 builds the game's own Guide (F1) suggests. Open any of them here as a plan: passive tree, Dragonling, skill with its supports and the item bases (the guide's rare items carry no stat lines, so the damage shown is lower than the guide's figure).

Unarmed attacks (no weapon in your main hand): the bare-fist base damage now grows with your level, as in the game. It was a fixed 12-27 Physical, so low-level characters were shown about 1.7x too much and level 100 characters about 0.6x too little. Game tests at levels 12 and 100 now match within 2-3%.

Facebreaker: tested in game. Its 500% more Physical damage only counts with nothing in your main hand; a claw or fist weapon there turns it off, even with Open Hand. A fist in the off hand is fine. The planner already worked this way.
Build Planner: with no character loaded, a Start fresh button starts a new plan from scratch (no code needed).
Home shows the landing page again when no character is loaded (it was blank since 25 Nov).

Configure Enemy: every curse now shows its own numbers. Woe of Entropy, Woe of Faltering, Woe of Rime, Sentence of Chains, Sentence of Rot and Unravel no longer show a raw {x}% or drop their slow and less-damage parts. The FAQ curse table adds Chaos damage taken and less damage dealt.

Guardians, corrected: a Woe and a Sentence both count on a Guardian and multiply, as Patch 84 says. Yesterday's change (only the bigger of the two) is undone: a game test on the Guardian Post read Death Sentence x1.33, Woe of Sundering x1.35 and both together x1.71.

Woes now count in full on a Guardian (they were counted at half). The same test showed Woe of Sundering at its full 36.5% on the Guardian Post. Every Woe build gains Guardian DPS; the resistance Woes lower resistance by their full amount there too.

Guardians: a Woe and a Sentence no longer multiply there. Only the bigger of the two counts, as the game's own data says (its Guardian rule is still switched on). Checked in the game on build 93: on a Guardian Post, Woe of Sundering next to Death Sentence added nothing. Builds with both lose Guardian DPS; a Woe on its own still counts at half its effect on a Guardian. The planner reads this rule from the game data, so it follows the game if the switch changes.

War Banner: Valour left blank now counts full Valour off a Guardian and none on a Guardian, where nothing dies near the banner (it used to count full Valour everywhere). Checked in the game on build 93: a banner on a Guardian Post gave 6% x its effect, no Valour. Also for a banner planted by an item or the tree. A Valour you type is used as typed.

Patch 94: Summon Skeletons, Summon Skeletal Mage and Raise Zombie now get their minions by gem level as the patch says (Skeletons 2, a 3rd at gem level 3, a 4th at 7; the 2nd Skeletal Mage at 10; Raise Zombie 1, the 2nd at 3). While fewer stand, each one deals more: as much as the count the gem reaches later (gem level 21 for Skeletons, 12 for the Mage, 23 for Zombies) divided by how many stand. Checked in the game on build 94: 3 Skeletons at gem level 5 each deal 4/3, a lone Skeleton pair at gem level 1 twice as much. From gem level 20 on, nothing changes.
Not checked yet: whether gem levels from supports or gear count toward these steps (the planner counts them), and whether extra minions from the tree or items lower the bonus (the planner says no).

Configure Enemy: a "Skill that shocks" picker (Auto, None, or one skill on your bar) chooses whose shock is counted. A Woe's Dread you type is now used as typed; leave it blank for the 10 it builds on a Rare or Guardian.
Recent Patch: Patch 94 in short.
